additional_info.subject: RE: ID0482604-DC/Si-D/FR- [MP / R8 170002500] OCPP Communication Instability CRM:03288000448
additional_info.body:
Dear Service Coordinator / RC,
I am writing to inform that we are moving the case
0482604
﻿from the Technical Support to the
eMobility RC-FR SI E Queue
. We kindly ask you to take over the case and perform the necessary troubleshooting steps.
Customer: Engie
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
MP / R8 170002500
Charger ID / Serial No.:
Fyz41s
Charger address/functional location:
Priority:
Medium
Handover reason: The charger has an instable OCPP Connection to the Backend. It disconnects daily several times. I run an analysis of the signal strength of router 2 over the last week, and the result is that the signal strength of network operator “F-Bouygues Telecom” is extremely weak, resulting into network disconnections.
I attach the logs from an AWS research. Follows here the interpretation of such logs: router2 - signal strength: {"stdout":"+QCSQ: \"LTE\",75,-113,81,-16\r\n\r\n","stderr":""}
-113 is the
RSRP (Reference Signal Received Power, signal strength). All samples are in the "Poor" category according to LTE standards (categories: Excellent > -80, Good > -90, Fair > -100, Poor ≤ -100)
-16 is the RSRQ (Reference Signal Received Quality). All samples are also "Poor" by LTE standards (categories: Excellent > -10, Good > -15, Poor ≤ -15).
I am handing over this ticket has the reason for such OCPP connectivity instability is the poor network with the current network operator.
Please advise the end customer to change network operator if possible with this SIM card, or to change SIM card itself with a different network operator.
Kindly pick up the case using "Pick" option in the queue or manually using the "Assign" function from the
eMobility RC-FR SI E Queue
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the case under Documents Tab on ISP.
In case you require Expert Support, kindly create Work-order as per
unified service process
. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
Kindly close the case post resolution following the case handling guidelines.
With kind regards,
Fosco Servidei
Siemens AG
eMobility Customer Service
Technical Support Engineer
SI E EU CS TS
Nonnendammallee 101
13629 Berlin, Germany
mailto:fosco.servidei@siemens.com
www.siemens.com
Important notice: This e-mail and any attachment thereof contain corporate proprietary information. If you have received it by mistake, please notify us immediately by reply e-mail and delete this e-mail and its attachments from your system.
Thank you.
